sources.title: Aya Expanse 32B model card
sources.evidence: Identifies the 32-billion-parameter, open-weight multilingual text model, its CC-BY-NC-4.0 license, 23 supported languages, autoregressive Transformer architecture and 128K context.

sources.title: Aya Expanse: Connecting our world
sources.evidence: Dated October 24, 2024. The launch identifies Aya Expanse as a model family; the embedded article body explicitly links the 32B release. Page metadata gives datePublished 2024-10-24.

sources.title: Aya Expanse: Combining Research Breakthroughs for a New Multilingual Frontier
sources.evidence: The December 2024 report names the exact 32B release. Section 3 specifies 128K training context, SwiGLU, RoPE and grouped-query attention. It describes ordinary role-delimited chat training and evaluates mathematical reasoning with prompted chain of thought; it does not give a separate Aya active-parameter count.

sources.title: Public Aya Expanse 32B repository metadata
sources.evidence: Public metadata at revision b306ea27e360683b50c005d7fcbad6a242317910 identifies CohereForCausalLM/model_type cohere. Its exact chat template supports optional system then alternating user/assistant turns, with no tools, tool_calls, tool-result or thinking serialization. The Hub reports 32,296,476,672 F16 parameters; this audit did not independently inspect their tensor headers.

sources.title: Cohere model implementation in Transformers 4.46.2
sources.evidence: Cohere-team implementation selected by the exact repository architecture has decoder layers with attention and a dense gated MLP (gate_proj, up_proj, down_proj), without expert routing. Read from the corresponding raw GitHub URL.

sources.title: An Overview of Cohere models
sources.evidence: Lists c4ai-aya-expanse-32b as a 32B text model with 128K context under Aya. Separately identifies Command A Reasoning as Cohere's first model with a dedicated thinking capability.

sources.title: Original Aya Expanse 32B configuration
sources.evidence: Direct request returned HTTP 401 because original files are gated; full configuration was not read.

sources.title: Original Aya Expanse 32B checkpoint index
sources.evidence: Direct request returned HTTP 401. No shard or tensor-header count was performed.

sources.title: Aya Vision: Advancing the Frontier of Multilingual Multimodality
sources.evidence: Later May 2025 report explicitly identifies Aya-Expanse-32B as the language-model base of Aya Vision 32B. It supplies no separate active-parameter count for the original Expanse checkpoint; no vision-model properties are transferred.

sources.title: Tiny Aya: Bridging Scale and Multilingual Depth
sources.evidence: Later March 2026 report was checked for Expanse parameter disclosures. It cites Aya Expanse but supplies no separate total/active table for the exact 32B model.

sources.title: Basic usage of tool use (function calling)
sources.evidence: Describes the native tool-use interface for the Command family; it does not establish that the Aya Expanse API has that feature. The exact released template is the evidence for the checkpoint interface.

developer.note: Developed by Cohere For AI, now Cohere Labs, the research arm of Cohere.

family.note: The launch and technical report explicitly call Aya Expanse a model family.

release_date.note: Explicit public launch date. Repository creation on October 23 is not evidence of public release that day; the December report is later.

open_weights.note: Weights are released for research under gated license acceptance.

license.note: Repository license declaration; the card additionally requires adherence to the Cohere Labs Acceptable Use Policy.

parameters_b.note: 32B is the developer-published nominal total. Hub metadata reports 32.296476672B F16 parameters, but original config/index access was denied, so no independently verified exact learned-tensor count replaces the nominal value.

active_parameters_b.note: No separate active-count definition was found in the original report or checked later primary reports. Dense execution is not used to equate active and total parameters.

architecture.note: Autoregressive decoder-only Transformer with GQA, RoPE and SwiGLU. Dense classification follows the exact repository's CohereForCausalLM implementation, whose decoder MLP has no expert routing.

context_window.note: The model card, report and exact API model row advertise 128K context; preserved as nominal 128,000 tokens. The gated configuration was not available to check its internal position limit.

modalities.note: The exact card explicitly specifies text-only input and output.

reasoning.note: No dedicated thinking mode in this released checkpoint's chat format. Reported chain-of-thought benchmark performance describes ordinary prompted text reasoning; Cohere distinguishes dedicated thinking models in its model documentation.

tool_call.note: No native tool-call interface in the released checkpoint: its template serializes only system/user/assistant text and has no tool definitions, tool-call fields or tool-result handling. This does not claim an inability to emit tool-like text when prompted.

description.value: Open-weight multilingual text model supporting 23 languages.
description.note: Plain summary of documented modality, access and language coverage.

patch.description: Open-weight multilingual text model supporting 23 languages.

sources.label: Aya Expanse: Combining Research Breakthroughs for a New Multilingual Frontier

patch.notes: 32B is the nominal published total; active parameters are not separately specified. The Hub reports 32.296476672B F16 parameters, but gated checkpoint files prevented an independent learned-tensor count. Context is advertised as 128K. The released template provides ordinary text chat without dedicated thinking or native tool-call formatting. The CC-BY-NC-4.0 release includes Cohere Labs' Acceptable Use Addendum.

summary: Confirmed the October 24, 2024 release, nominal 32B total, CC-BY-NC-4.0 open weights, 128K text context and 23-language scope. Added Aya Expanse family and dense Transformer classification, and upgraded parameter provenance to the primary model card. Exact repository metadata verifies the plain chat template. Active count remains undisclosed; gated original config/index prevented an independent exact tensor count.
